about: Site tests for each land pathway. Every test cites the HCD Housing Law Fact Sheet (April 2026 versions) it was taken from. A fact sheet summary is not the statute: confirm against the Government Code before relying on any result. Tests whose data we do not have always return 'unknown'. Prototype only, not legal advice.

hcd_sb9.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheet: Duplexes and Lot Splits (SB 9), April 2026

hcd_sb4.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheet: Affordable Housing on Faith & Higher Education Lands Act (SB 4), April 2026

hcd_shra.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheets (combined): Starter Home Revitalization Act (SB 684 / SB 1123), April 2026

hcd_ab2011.title: HCD Housing Law Fact Sheets (combined): Affordable Housing & High Road Jobs Act (AB 2011), April 2026

laws.name: SB 9: duplex and/or lot split
laws.what: Up to two primary units on a single-family lot, and/or splitting it into two lots (up to two units on each).

tests.label: Zoned single-family residential
tests.quote: A lot zoned for single-family residential within an urbanized area may be developed by right

tests.label: Inside an urbanized area
tests.quote: within an urbanized area

tests.label: Not in a special flood hazard area (one of the Gov. Code 65913.4(a)(6) exclusions)
tests.quote: Specified environmentally sensitive, hazardous, or protected lands ... as listed in Government Code section 65913.4, subdivision (a)(6)(B)-(K)

tests.label: Not in a very high fire hazard severity zone (65913.4(a)(6) exclusion)
tests.quote: as listed in Government Code section 65913.4, subdivision (a)(6)(B)-(K)

tests.label: Not a contributing structure in a historic district or a listed historical resource
tests.why: No historic-district layer loaded for Santa Ana yet.
tests.quote: A contributing structure within a historic district or a historical resource on the State Historic Resource Inventory

tests.label: Does not demolish or alter housing occupied by a tenant in the last 3 years
tests.why: Tenancy history is not public data (and would be personal information).
tests.quote: Has been occupied by a tenant in the last three years.

tests.label: No Ellis Act withdrawal in the last 15 years
tests.why: No public Ellis Act layer found.
tests.quote: A parcel where units were withdrawn from the rental market pursuant to the Ellis Act in the last 15 years.

tests.label: Not created by a previous SB 9 lot split
tests.why: Lot-split history is not in the parcel layer.
tests.quote: Parcels previously created under SB 9 lot split provisions are not eligible for further lot splits.

laws.name: SB 684: small-lot subdivision, multifamily zone (up to 10 homes)
laws.what: Ministerial approval of up to 10 lots / 10 units on an urban lot zoned for multifamily residential use.

tests.label: Zoned for multifamily residential use
tests.quote: urban lots under five acres zoned for multifamily residential use

tests.label: Lot is 5 acres or smaller
tests.conflict: The fact sheet says 'under five acres' in its introduction and '5 acres or less' in its SB 684 summary. A parcel of exactly 5 acres is flagged for review.
tests.quote: urban lots of 5 acres or less

tests.label: In an incorporated city
tests.quote: located in incorporated cities or large urban counties

tests.label: Not in a fire hazard zone
tests.note: The fact sheet says 'fire hazard zones' without naming a severity level. We check very-high only; read Gov. Code 65852.28 for the exact test.
tests.quote: Environmentally sensitive areas, including farmland, wetlands, and fire hazard zones, are ineligible

tests.label: Does not displace rent-controlled or tenant-occupied housing
tests.why: Tenancy and rent-control status per unit are not public data.
tests.quote: prohibiting redevelopment that displaces rent-controlled or tenant-occupied housing

tests.label: Not wetlands or farmland
tests.why: No wetlands or farmland layer loaded yet.
tests.quote: including farmland, wetlands

laws.name: SB 1123: small-lot subdivision, vacant single-family lot (up to 10 homes)
laws.what: Extends SB 684's streamlined process to vacant lots in single-family zones (effective July 1, 2025).

tests.label: Zoned single-family
tests.quote: enabling property owners in single-family zones to utilize the same streamlined, ministerial approval process

tests.label: Lot is vacant (no building footprint)
tests.quote: Expansion of Streamlined Housing Approvals for Vacant Single-Family Lots

tests.label: Meets the SB 1123 lot-size limit
tests.why: The HCD fact sheet does not state the size limit for single-family lots. Read Gov. Code 66499.41 before using this pathway.

tests.label: Not in a fire hazard zone
tests.quote: Environmentally sensitive areas, including farmland, wetlands, and fire hazard zones, are ineligible

laws.name: AB 2011: housing on commercial land
laws.what: By-right 100% affordable or mixed-income housing on sites that allow office, retail or parking uses.

tests.label: Zone allows commercial uses (office, retail, parking)
tests.quote: streamlined, ministerial review process for housing projects on sites that allow commercial uses (office, retail, and parking)

tests.label: Meets AB 2011's environmental, vacant-site, replacement-housing and density criteria
tests.why: The HCD fact sheet lists these only by category. Read Gov. Code 65912.111 (100% affordable) or 65912.121 (mixed-income).
tests.quote: environmental criteria, replacement housing, limitations for vacant sites, and specified densities

tests.label: Not exempted by Santa Ana under AB 2011's exempt-and-replace option
tests.why: HCD sent Santa Ana a technical assistance letter on parcel exemptions (Dec 10, 2024). Check the city's adopted ordinance for this APN.
tests.quote: Parcel exemptions are allowed only if local governments provide written findings demonstrating no net loss in housing capacity

laws.name: SB 4: faith or nonprofit-college land
laws.what: By-right 100% affordable housing on land owned by a religious institution or independent college as of Jan 1, 2024. Allowed in all zones.

tests.label: Owned by a religious institution or independent college as of Jan 1, 2024
tests.quote: the property must have been owned by a religious institution or independent higher education institution (including through an affiliated nonprofit) as of January 1, 2024

tests.label: City includes part of an urbanized area or urban cluster
tests.quote: a city where the city boundaries include some portion of an urbanized area or urban cluster

tests.label: Not in a very high fire hazard severity zone
tests.quote: very high fire hazard severity zone

tests.label: Not in a special flood hazard area
tests.quote: special flood hazard area

tests.label: Not within 1,200 ft of land zoned heavy industrial
tests.note: The fact sheet says 'a site permitted for heavy industrial use'. We use heavy-industrial zoning as a proxy for that.
tests.quote: Within 1,200 feet of a site permitted for heavy industrial use

tests.label: At least 75% of the site's perimeter adjoins urban uses
tests.quote: At least 75 percent of the perimeter of the site adjoins parcels that are developed with urban uses.

tests.label: Not in an earthquake fault zone
tests.why: The CGS fault-zone service requires a token; not loaded.
tests.quote: earthquake fault zone

tests.label: Not next to a site that is more than one-third light industrial
tests.quote: Adjacent to a site where more than one-third of the square footage is dedicated to light industrial use
